answer.rationale: Run a standard activation-messaging experiment focused on helping price-sensitive SMB accounts reach their first meaningful outcome quickly. Prior evidence shows activation messaging improves week-one engagement, while shorter onboarding improves time-to-value. Avoid matching the competitor with broad discounts: the recovered pricing experiment increased qualified revenue short term but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, undermining sustainable long-term revenue. Treat this as a guarded retention and value-realization response rather than assuming it fully offsets competitive pricing pressure.
